coops.source_scope: NOAA CO-OPS three monitored U.S. station levels

eonet.source_scope: NASA EONET open events, seven-day bounded global sample

imd_in.source_scope: India Meteorological Department CAP RSS relayed by WMO Alert Hub; India-only, not a second observer

inmet_br.source_scope: Brazil INMET official severe-weather RSS notices; provider-listed bounded sample

ioda.source_scope: IODA country events (first 100 of first page, 4-hour query)

live_airspace.source_scope: FAA temporary flight restrictions: United States only

nga.source_scope: NGA active broadcast warnings; provider availability varies

nws.source_scope: NWS marine weather alerts (bounded United States sample)

official.source_scope: US State and UK FCDO travel-advice feeds

ons_br.source_scope: Brazilian national system operator ONS verified half-hour load, four macroregions, previous two-day sample; no local facilities/outage attribution

ris_bgp.source_scope: RIPE RIS public route-announcement update samples on six non-Western operated networks; ASNs not country-wide outage detection

saws_za.source_scope: South African Weather Service CAP RSS relayed by WMO Alert Hub; South Africa-only

uk_tenders.source_scope: UK Find a Tender official two-day bounded release sample

usace.source_scope: USACE inland navigation notices beginning in last 14 days

usgs.source_scope: USGS M4.5+ earthquake feed (one-day global sample)
